response.justification: Bogdan has strong full-stack experience and notable geospatial project contributions via GISCollective, but lacks direct C++/Rust experience in production routing or geospatial data pipelines, and his recent work is primarily in TypeScript/Node.js — a mismatch with the role’s core requirement of modern C++ for routing tile systems.
strengths: Built and maintained open-source geospatial platform (GISCollective) with real-world usage
Demonstrated ability to work across diverse tech stacks and learn new languages quickly
Strong background in testing, CI/CD, and system reliability practices
concerns: No demonstrated commercial experience with C++ or Rust in routing or geospatial data pipelines
Recent roles focus on TypeScript/Node.js, not low-latency systems or distributed map data processing
Limited evidence of OS/distributed systems expertise (fault tolerance, consistency) in production
